title: Coherent ultraviolet dispersion has the sharp negative-scale phase boundary beta times s plus four equals nine

coherent_model.dispersion_and_covariance: For beta>0 and smoothing exponent s>=0 use epsilon_beta(k)=omega_k^beta, q_beta(k)=(2 epsilon_beta(k))^(-1), H_beta=dGamma(epsilon_beta), and construct W_(beta,N) from that same Gaussian covariance
coherent_model.lower_blocks: Comparable three-free-momentum cone blocks of radius R contribute at least c R^(9-beta(s+4))
coherent_model.upper_shells: Ordered dyadic shells L~N1~N2>=N3>=N4 contribute at most C L^(9-beta(s+4)) after summing the two smaller radii; equality produces a non-summable constant dyadic contribution
coherent_model.phase_boundary: S_(beta,s)(N) converges exactly when beta(s+4)>9 and is unbounded when beta(s+4)<=9
coherent_model.checks: beta=1 recovers K1440's s>5 threshold; s=0 requires beta>9/4; the form-dual exponent s=1 requires beta>9/5
coherent_model.ceiling: Changing beta changes both the free dispersion and Gaussian representation. The phase diagram does not repair or describe the original beta=1 interaction
